description: Review + QA review (ADR-017 D6). Reviews the change and audits the QA evidence against the confirmed acceptance criteria in one Flow, then judges task completion from both. The diff is optional: without it the review steps are skipped and the QA audit still runs, because the basic QA is never omitted.

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: The task and its confirmed acceptance criteria.

inputs.name: diff
inputs.description: The change claimed to complete the task. Optional: absence skips the review steps.

inputs.name: tests
inputs.description: Test evidence. Optional: absence degrades the completion judgment.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.description: The plan the task belongs to. Optional: absence skips the task-versus-plan cross-check.

inputs.name: qa-evidence
inputs.description: The QA evidence a person ran. Optional: absence degrades the completion judgment, which is then never COMPLETE.

steps.description: Missing `tasks` stops here (the only required input).
Task against the plan it belongs to.
Without QA evidence or test evidence this runs in a reduced form and records the degradation.
